name: Migrate log UI
description: A smarter admin UI for browsing migration messages: an overview of all migrations plus a filterable, paged, sortable per-migration message log viewer.
project_description:
Migrate Log UI module allows easy viewing and filtering of migration messages. Migration messages can be filtered by source key, message type, and message content. The filter can also be negative.

 Features 
 Viewing and filtering of migration messages.

 Additional Requirements 
 Migrate (core) module should be enabled. No additional requirements.
